couldNotReachFreero: Freero couldn’t be reached. Try again.
embeddingOffOwner: A board shows here only while embedding is on. You own this one: turn embedding on to use it.
embeddingOffOther: Its owner hasn’t turned embedding on, so it can’t be shown here. Ask them to (Share → Embed).
thisWindowPicksABoard: This window picks a board for Freero in your meeting. Open it with “Choose from your boards” there.
signInToChoose: Sign in to choose one of your boards. A new tab opens; come back here when you’re signed in.
everyoneSeesItAsShared: Everyone sees the board as Freero shares it with them: people it is shared with edit or comment, and a board anyone with the link may view shows read-only to everyone else.
openFreeroInZoomText: This page runs inside a Zoom meeting: in Zoom, open Apps and choose Freero.
showABoardInMeeting: Show a Freero board in this meeting
thatIsntALink: That isn’t a link to a board on {host}.
boardCantBeShown: This board can’t be shown here: its owner hasn’t turned embedding on.
popupBlockedText: Your browser blocked Freero’s window. Allow pop-ups for this page and try again.
signInZoomHint: Sign in with your Freero password or your organisation’s single sign-on. Signing in with Google may not work inside Zoom.
invitationSent: Everyone in the meeting was invited to open this board.
signInToInvite: Sign in to invite everyone to this board.
freeroIsAddedToZoomText: In a Zoom meeting, open Apps and choose Freero to show a board. You can close this page.
openThisInMeetText: This page runs inside a Google Meet call: in Meet, open Activities and choose Freero.
showABoardInCall: Show a Freero board in this call
openOnStage: Open on the main stage for everyone
othersAreAsked: Everyone else in the call is asked to join, and sees the board as Freero shares it with them.
onTheStageUntitled: The board is on the main stage
couldNotStart: Google Meet didn’t open the board on the main stage.
